text:
maya: FYI — GPU driver regression hit the int8 runtime; rollout for the optimized kernels is delayed ~2w. This affects Dedicated performance targets for v1. Need to agree on cuts and comms. :frowning:
liam: Which variants are impacted exactly?
maya: int8 path on A100 and A10g. So redwood-quant-v1 variants and anything we planned to pin for Dedicated. Acme and BetaHealth pilots could see throughput drop.
chen: Ops confirms earliest fix ETA 2026-05-12, plus validation/canary -> ~2026-05-26 for full confidence.
zoe: Proposing a minimal launch slice to protect SLA and pilot validity:
- Keep: embeddings cache, basic SLA enforcement, simple model pinning, API contract
- Defer: tenant-scoped routing, advanced rollout controls (A/B), analytics dashboard polish
- Optional post-launch canary features: autopin heuristics, per-tenant rate UI
andre: Agree. Telemetry pipeline overhaul can be a v1.1 item. Low direct impact on pilot success.
sam: CS note: BetaHealth expects May pilot. If tenant-routing is trimmed we must provide a migration plan and updated success criteria.
liam: Roadmap change: shift v1 GA window from 2026-05-24 to 2026-06-07 (soft). Add a customer-comm task and rollback playbook.
maya: Draft cutlist (locking if no objections by 15:00 PT):
```
- Keep: embeddings cache, core SLA checks, basic pinning API
- Defer to v1.1: tenant-routing, advanced rollout/A-B, analytics dashboards
- Defer to backlog: UI polish, non-blocking telemetry refactor
```
product-bot: scope-huddle scheduled today 15:30 PT. Invites to @eng-runtime @customer-success @prod.
zoe: I'll update the milestone board and add the "communication + rollback" ticket. Link: https://confluence.redwood/scope-slices
chen: I'll own hotfix verification and canary plan. Prioritizing smoke tests on the driver fix path.
sam: I'll prepare the customer one-pager and a staging checklist for BetaHealth.
andre: I'll mark telemetry PRs as optional for launch and move blockers to v1.1 milestone.
maya: Please flag objections before 15:00. If none, we'll lock cutlist and send CS comms. :white_check_mark:
liam: No objections from infra. We'll aim for an accelerated canary once the fix lands.
zoe: :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks everyone — locking changes unless someone speaks up.
